method: Observed: viewed downscaled contact sheets of all ref/ and assets/images/*.jpg files plus 4 upscaled slices of the 517x1600 reference. Pixel diff (mean abs luminance diff on 200px thumbnails, used for ranking only, not a similarity score) shows each assets/images/*.jpg is a re-encode of the named ref/*.png source. Not run: no browser rendering was done for this manifest.
caveat: exact_match=true means the asset is the same source image as the one used in the reference mockup (same pixels up to crop/encode). The reference is a downscaled AI-style mockup, so overlays, gradients and some details are not reproducible from the image alone.
